item.description:
リック・アンド・モーティ：ジ・アニメ [JP]
Rick and Morty: The Anime [EN]
1080p BluRay REMUX DD2.0 AVC-NOGRP

Synopsis:​
It's life mostly as usual for the Smith family. Rick relaxes in a pseudo-world between multiverses, Summer helps Space Beth fight the evil Galactic Federation, and Morty falls in love with a mysterious girl. And they're all an anime.
Click to expand...
Notes:​
· Original video is my own untampered BluRay REMUX of the series. I also decided to add no release group attached to this as opposed to having my alias added for no other reason.

· English release naming scheme is used, but the file names have the original Japanese-language episode and series titles.

· ALL OFFICIAL AUDIO AND SUBTITLE TRACKS FROM HBO MAX AND AMAZON INCLUDED; SYNCED TO THE OFFICIAL BLU-RAY ALMOST SEAMLESSLY. The only language tracks that needed minor re-encoding for additional edits were in episodes 7-10, as I wanted to avoid and remove noticeable audio de-sync; the streaming version does not match the official home media release, as on the BluRay there's some extra blank video/audio space added. Aside from that, any HBO Max/Amazon audio tracks that have no re-encoding are kept in their un-tampered EAC3 codec (Dolby Digital Plus).

· German, Italian, Russian and Ukrainian audio tracks were downloaded from HBO Max. The rest were downloaded from HBO Max's Amazon Prime Video channel due to having a better bit-rate available.

· The only minor fan-made addition that was added to this release was custom forced subtitles in languages that were missing or needed (specifically Japanese, Czech and Hungarian).
